Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Adam Frazier?

Adam Frazier is 34 years old.

When was Adam Frazier born?

Adam Frazier was born on December 14, 1991.

Where was Adam Frazier born?

Adam Frazier was born in Athens, GA.

How tall is Adam Frazier?

Adam Frazier is 5-10 (178 cm) tall.

How much does Adam Frazier weigh?

Adam Frazier weighs 190 lbs (86 kg).

How many seasons has Adam Frazier played?

Adam Frazier is in his 11th season.

When was Adam Frazier drafted?

Adam Frazier was drafted by the Pittsburgh Pirates in the 6th round of the 2013 MLB June Amateur Draft from Mississippi State University (Mississippi State, MS).

What position does Adam Frazier play?

Adam Frazier is a Second Baseman and Outfielder.

How many hits does Adam Frazier have?

Adam Frazier has 17 hits this season and has 1,032 hits over his career.

How many home runs does Adam Frazier have?

Adam Frazier has 1 home run this season and has 68 home runs over his career.

What is Adam Frazier's average?

Adam Frazier has a .210 average this season and has a .263 average over his career.

How many teams has Adam Frazier played for?

Adam Frazier has played for 6 teams; the Los Angeles Angels, Baltimore Orioles, Kansas City Royals, Pittsburgh Pirates, San Diego Padres and Seattle Mariners.

How many World Series has Adam Frazier won?

Adam Frazier has never won a World Series.

What is Adam Frazier's Instagram account?

Adam Frazier is on Instagram at a_fraz12.

What are Adam Frazier's nicknames?

Fraz is a nickname for Adam Frazier.
